description.title: הגדרות פוליסה
description.summary: This table defines terms used in an insurance policy. It helps clarify what is and isn't covered by looking up a concept to see its specific meaning within the policy.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח עסקית מגדירה מונחים שונים, כגון 'זיהום' המתייחס לנזק כתוצאה מפריקת חומרים מזהמים לקרקע, לאוויר או למים. כמו כן, מוגדרים 'קנסות' ו'עונשים' כנזקים שאינם מכוסים. הפוליסה גם מתייחסת להפרה של זכויות קניין רוחני.
notable_values: Pollution: Damage arising from discharge of chemicals
Fines: Penalties resulting from multiplication of damages
Infringement: Alleged violation of patent or copyright
Personal injury: Coverage for advertising injury

sketch:
12. Pollution meaning
Damage, Loss or Injury arising out of the discharge, dispersal, release or escape  of  smoke,  vapours,  soot,  fumes,  acids,  alkalis,  toxic  chemicals, liquids or gases, waste materials or irritants, contaminants into or upon land, the atmosphere or any watercourse or body of water.
Fines,  Penalties,  Punitive  or  Exemplary  Damages  or  any  other  damage resulting from the multiplication of compensatory damages.
Actual  or  alleged  infringement  of  patent  copyright,  trademark,  service mark, design right, registered design right, passing off, theft or misuse of confidential information or other intellectual property, computer systems or programmes of others.
Personal injury of advertising injury.
Directors,  officers  or  employees  of  the  Insured  acting  as  directors  or officers of any company or organisation.
Insolvency or bankruptcy of the Insured.

טבלה: הגדרות פוליסה
This table defines terms used in an insurance policy. It helps clarify what is and isn't covered by looking up a concept to see its specific meaning within the policy.

12. Pollution meaning

Fines,  Penalties,  Punitive  or  Exemplary  Damages  or  any  other  damage resulting from the multiplication of compensatory damages.
Actual  or  alleged  infringement  of  patent  copyright,  trademark,  service mark, design right, registered design right, passing off, theft or misuse of confidential information or other intellectual property, computer systems or programmes of others.
Personal injury of advertising injury.
Directors,  officers  or  employees  of  the  Insured  acting  as  directors  or officers of any company or organisation.
